label: A10B10C_hP63_171_5c_5c_b-001
title: MnB$_{10}$H$_{10}$ Structure
comments: Space group \href{current_web_home_dir/hexagonal_spacegroup.html#sg171}{$P6_{2}$ \#171} is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups#ClassII}{chiral, Sohncke Class II}.  A mirror reflection of this structure will put it in the enantiomorphic space group \href{current_web_home_dir/hexagonal_spacegroup.html#sg172}{$P6_{4}$ \#172}.  Each structure has the same energy, which orientation will form depends upon the formation process.
